description_en: Triggers the execution of a specified data quality monitoring task and returns the run instance ID
description_zh: 触发指定数据质量监控任务的执行，并返回运行实例ID
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-data-quality-scan-run --data-quality-scan-id 20000001 --project-id 10000 --parameters Value=1775812636 Name=triggerTime --runtime-resource Cu=0.25 Id=e9455a13-ff00-4965-833c-337546ba4854 Image=i-xxxxxx --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataQualityScanRun

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data quality monitoring task
parameters.name: data_quality_scan_id

fields.help_en:
The parameter name. Currently supported parameter:
triggerTime

Other scheduling parameters are not supported
fields.help_zh:
参数名，目前支持参数为：
triggerTime

暂不支持其它调度参数
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The parameter value:
If the parameter name is triggerTime, the value must be the timestamp of the scheduling time
fields.help_zh:
参数值：
当参数名为triggerTime时，参数值应为调度时间的时间戳
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The parameter settings used during the actual run. The `triggerTime` parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 实际运行时，使用的参数设置，其中必传参数`triggerTime`
parameters.name: parameters

fields.help_en: The CU configuration reserved for the resource group when running the data quality monitoring task
fields.help_zh: 资源组运行数据质量监控时预留的CU配置
fields.name: cu

fields.help_en: The image settings used when running the data quality monitoring task on the resource group
fields.help_zh: 使用资源组运行数据质量监控时的镜像设置
fields.name: image

parameters.help_en: The schedule resource group used when the data quality monitoring task runs. This shares the same data structure as the scheduling API
parameters.help_zh: 数据质量监控运行时，所使用的调度资源组，与调度API共用相同的数据结构
parameters.name: runtime_resource

Id.description_en: The run ID of the successfully triggered task
